scale: The 12 small ORE 2015 DL files of roadmap item 709, GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256, ore_ont_3836 and 13482 of the ORE 2015 EL sample, ore_ont_7914 and ore_ont_8737 of the ORE 2015 DL development set on atlas

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley, copied to atlas. The full hashes of every side are in each part's env.txt and log.txt.

sides.base: dbac7667, local main when the lane started
sides.pre: dbac7667 with the lazy start of item 709 and the delivery filter of item 695 removed, the build before those items
sides.f: 70a5234c: one-thread batching once congested and a start delay of the time until the last helper ran
sides.b: 9159097c: f with the deduplication of congested deliveries, an experiment
sides.g: the tree of 71f4fa5d before its comments and names changed: the start delay of the first worker's time in the spawns
sides.h: 70a5234c with a fixed 100 us delay once a start has happened, the experiment cb41dc13
sides.g2: 5dca16bd, the lane: g with a look at the clock after every activation until the helpers start

method: Each part ran under ~/lanes/.heavy.lock on atlas with no other benchmark or gate on the host. cold.sh ran, per round, file and side in rotating order, one process with one classification, whose time is the cold one, and one with ten, whose last nine give the warm median. ab.sh ran one process per side, file and thread count with --repeat 5 in rotating order, and each round's value is the process's median classification. perf ran one-thread processes pinned to CPU 4 under perf stat. mem ran one classification of ore_ont_8737 per side and thread count. repro is the reproduction before any change, slot the run of f and b, variants the cold rounds of f, g and h, and final the run of g and g2.

checks.taxonomies: Every ab.sh part wrote each side's taxonomy and hashed it sorted, and the hashes of all sides agree for every file and thread count. taxcheck.sh.txt classified the 298 ORE 2015 EL files, GO and ChEBI lite with base and the lane on one and eight threads on stanley, with the same taxonomy for every file, side and thread count.

notes: atlas had no swap in use and 6 to 10% I/O wait from two blocked tasks that did no I/O during the slot, final and variants parts, and 7.6 GB of stale swap during the reproduction, whose rounds of ChEBI lite and ore_ont_13482 spread by 18 to 50%. ChEBI lite's eight-thread rounds spread by 9 to 13% in the final part. The memory runs of the four-thread side vary between runs of the same code, from 6.8 to 7.9 GiB.
